user.title: Connect to MeshMonitor
user.description: Enter the connection details for your MeshMonitor instance. Generate an API token from MeshMonitor's own web UI under User Settings, then paste it here.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate MeshMonitor
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for this MeshMonitor instance no longer works (it may have been rotated or revoked). Paste a new token from MeshMonitor's User Settings page.

zeroconf_confirm.title: MeshMonitor discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found a MeshMonitor instance at `{host}:{port}` advertised by its companion bridge script. Generate an API token from MeshMonitor's own web UI under User Settings, then paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: The API token was rejected by MeshMonitor. Check that you copied it correctly and that it hasn't been revoked.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach MeshMonitor at that host/port/scheme. Check the connection details and that MeshMonitor is running.
error.unknown: MeshMonitor responded, but not in the shape expected. Check that this is a MeshMonitor instance and that the version is supported.

abort.already_configured: This MeshMonitor instance is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: This MeshMonitor instance is already being configured.
